newsitem.title: USA: Broadcast Partners says paid $5.1mln for stations.
newsitem.headline: Broadcast Partners says paid $5.1mln for stations.

text.p: Broadcast Partners Holdings L.P. said it has bought three Monroe, La. radio stations for $5.1 million from three seperate owners. At the same time, Broadcast Partners said it has created a new company called Sound Broadcasting LLC, which will run the newly acquired stations.
In a statement, the company said it bought KMYY-FM from Radioactive Images Inc; KYEA-FM from Phoenix Broadcasting Co; and KCTO-FM from Tom Gray.

Broadcasting Partners was formed in January 1997 by VS&A Communications Partners II, L.P., a $330 million private equity fund affiliated with the New York media and communications investment bank Veronis, Suhler & Associates.
